# Effect Specialist

> > Professional special effects equipment rental specializing in Snowmasters evaporative snow machines, CO2 cryo jets, confetti cannons, and theatrical effects for Disney, theme parks, and major events across Florida.

Effect Specialist (operated by Zigmont Magic FX) provides high-end special effects rental equipment and services throughout Florida, with extensive experience serving Disney World, Legoland, NASCAR events, and corporate productions. The company specializes in realistic evaporative snow effects using Snowmasters professional-grade machines, along with pyrotechnics, water effects, and atmospheric systems.

- Snowmasters evaporative snow machines
- Disney theme park effects
- CO2 cryo jets and cannons
- Confetti and streamer cannons

- Florida event production
- T-1500 and T-1100 snow machines

- Tampa and Orlando services
